what_this_establishes: The X4 donor model follows from the proved authority primitives rather than standing beside them. Each of the seven arguments X4 takes is assigned to the calculus conjunct it means -- type-coordinate agreement or a registered coercion is the calculus Reach, narrowing is scope containment, the blocker is an obligation and a defeater -- and the calculus rule, evaluated under that assignment, reproduces X4 exactly on all 3,072 distinct states, with all four terminals reached. It is a derivation and not a transcription: three independent changes to X4 semantics each make the derived verdict disagree.
